assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic events.
The service is Mobile cardiac telemetry.
The service is evaluated under CPT 93229.
The service is directly aligned with the documented indication.
The service supports the evaluation of the member's symptomatic presentation.
The service supports the evaluation under the listed diagnoses I25.10 and R42.
The listed diagnoses are I25.10 and R42.
